doc.title: Ed Soph interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 9, 2024

title: The hubcap cymbal
summary: As a six-year-old he hammered a neighbor's Packard hubcap into a cymbal and got in trouble; he dreamed of a drumset.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Now tell me about, there’s this rumor going around that you borrowed someone’s hubcap to make a cymbal. Is that true?

Yeah that’s true. Yeah. It was a neighbor about two doors down who had one of those big black ominous Packards. And I decided I needed and wanted a cymbal. So I took a hubcap, and then got a ball peen hammer and beat the hell out of it. I had a cymbal. So I caught hell for that.
Oh six. I was wondering when you started — this is an assumption on my part — that you started fantasizing about this wonderful drumset, that if only I could have one.
